_note: What's new, in plain words (lane Site r3). `features`: one entry per day or range of days (`date`, optional `until`, a short `title`, `items` of short sentences a visitor would understand; HTML is allowed, so write & as &; optional `toy` is the id of a toy whose picture goes with it). `fixes`: a before-and-after pair, each side a git ref and the path of a file at that ref (`id` names the pictures; `toy` is the toy it shows; `line` is one plain sentence). Run `node tools/site-news-shots.mjs` to copy the pictures into site/assets/news/. New toys are not listed here: they come from tools/toy-dates.json. Nothing operational: no lanes, PR numbers, tests or model names.

features.title: Gallery is now Playground
items: The app's Gallery is now called the Playground: one button, every toy on one page. Old links and saved scenes keep working.
Every toy page now shows the day the toy arrived, and the toy lists have a Newest first view.

features.title: Real rocks, fossils and the night sky (in the labs)
items: Photoreal captures of a Triceratops skull, a cone shell, meteorites, fossils and minerals, with parts that move as solid pieces.
A celestial globe and an armillary sphere.

features.title: Hands-on toys
items: More toys you can pick up, drop and throw, and that land and settle like the real thing: food, nature, vehicles, landmarks, space, weather and the tiny world, plus music, medieval and holiday toys.
Clothing, an Enigma machine and sharper photo views.

features.title: Real data: planets, maps, orbits and shapes in four dimensions (in the labs)
items: The real Moon, Mars, Earth, Mercury and Venus, real moons and stars, and the solar system on real orbits.
Real maps and measurements: the Grand Canyon, the sea floor, tides, hurricanes, earthquakes and stork migration.
Simulations and shapes: a ripple tank, a light bench, strange attractors, 4D shapes and a volume viewer.
More QR codes: a picture made of a QR code, QR codes from real things and other barcodes.

features.title: A new site, a QR lab and ways to see inside things
items: A preview of a new Splashery site: a home page, one menu everywhere, search, and a copy that keeps working offline.
A QR code lab: see how a QR code works, damage one on purpose and watch how much it can lose.
New imaging toys: an airport X-ray scanner, how CT works, a real CT scan of a walnut, an MRI of a fruit, an electron microscope and a thermal camera.
The alarm clock now tells the real time.

features.title: Toys you can pick up, and a gentler manual
items: Hands-on toys: pick up a basketball, a beach ball or a snow globe, drop it, and watch it land and settle.
The Fluid lab works on a phone.
The Tinkerer's Manual was rewritten for a newcomer.
Moving photo to 3D keeps the sound and the speed of your clip, and the splat mirror holds still again.

features.title: A QR code made of splats
items: A QR code generator whose codes are made of splats, with a check that the code still scans.
Hands-on showcase toys and a small physics engine under them.
Pages in a book can carry links, and figures can pop out of the page.
Sharper trained splats on our own toys, and a piano bar with new rotation defaults.

features.title: Real science data, a faucet and film-your-own 3D
items: Science toys: crystals with thermal ellipsoids that now work well on a phone, with pinch-and-scroll zoom.
The song landscape gained tilt, recording and playback controls; the Chladni plate's sand was fixed; Moving photo to 3D arrived.
A tappable faucet, water that reads as water and real lava in the Fluid lab.
Video to 3D now tells you what to film and why a result failed, and steers the flight.

features.title: Use your microphone, camera or screen, and film a scene
items: Toys can use the microphone, the camera or screen capture, but only when you tap to start.
Real recorded sounds for the first shelves of toys.
Focus mode, bigger panels and a drawing pad.
Photo to 3D opens your own photos, and an early version of Video to 3D arrived.

features.title: Liquids, pianos and your photo in depth
items: The Fluid lab: liquids, smoke, steam and flames made of splats.
Four keyboards with moving keys and mechanisms, songs and a song bar.
Photo to 3D turns a photo into a depth relief on your device.
Books with pages you tap and pull, and sharper screens with a real off switch.
Seven everyday objects with moving parts, and a sharper island in Worlds.

features.title: The chemistry set, machines and a sharper picture
items: Chemistry: a periodic table, all 118 elements in the atom toy and many more molecules, crystals and orbitals.
Machines that compute: a Turing machine, a difference engine, an Enigma machine and a Bombe.
Splats are drawn sharper by default, and a Detail setting picks how many a toy gets.
The Tinkerer's Manual and the lab notebook, the anatomy atlas with layers you peel, and the song landscape's Live view.
A short terms-of-use page in the About tab.

features.title: Math, AI and your own pages
items: Math toys: a graph plotter, a surface plotter, circles and waves, Fourier circles and a Pythagoras proof.
A shelf of AI and computing toys where you watch the data move, including a network that reads a digit you draw.
Every toy got a how-to line and an About text.
PDFs, photos, GIFs and videos can be turned into splats, and a book shows any PDF with turning pages.

features.title: Toys you can reach into
items: The puzzle cube turns under your finger, the bricks build models, chess takes your moves and Newton's cradle balls can be dragged.
A real pencil and a real tin can, made from photos with an image-to-3D model.

features.title: The first toy box
items: Sharper splats on phones and computers, and a phone shelf shown as a full grid.
A sound for every toy, and new tap effects for well over a hundred toys across the shelves: fruit, balls, space, atoms, gems, the tiny world, the body, nature and weather.
A chess set you can play and a laptop you can type on.

fixes.title: Fireworks
fixes.line: The fireworks bloom into bigger, fuller bursts.

fixes.title: Sunglasses
fixes.line: The glasses show their lenses and frame more clearly.

fixes.title: Orange
fixes.line: The orange and its cut half are drawn smoother and sharper.

fixes.title: The real Venus
fixes.line: Finer splats, so the planet's surface is smooth, not speckled.

fixes.title: 5-cell
fixes.line: The 4D shape now shows its whole self, not a speck.
